title: Lanes lock file
description: lanes.lock.json (ADR 0016): the version of lanes a project runs and the sha256 of every file the upgrade installed, so an upgrade can tell a local edit from a stale copy. Strict: no other keys, and every path is repo-relative with no `..` segment, no leading `/` or `\`, no drive letter and no backslash, so a hand-edited lock cannot point an upgrade outside the repository. lanes.lock.json is an owner path (lanes.config.json paths.owner), so a lane cannot edit it.

version.description: The lanes release the files came from, as a semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optional -prerelease and +build).

files.description: Repo-relative path to the sha256 of that file as installed.

repoPath.description: Repo-relative, forward slashes, no `.` or `..` or empty segment, no segment ending in a dot or space (Windows strips them), no leading `/`, no `:` (drive letter, NTFS stream), no backslash or control character.
